evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Seven years of experience, an eight-hour scenario practical and longstanding vendor recognition support senior architecture decisions; product focus and renewal cost limit portability rather than the demonstrated level.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: An eight-hour scenario practical and seven-year profile strongly filter for senior design judgment. Vendor emphasis and renewal cost are limitations, but the performance-based architecture assessment supports expert placement.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded eight-hour scenario practical, seven-year profile and architecture-level design scope justify expert placement. Cisco dependence narrows portability but does not erase the substantial applied design assessment.
